pages.text: A comet is a ball of ice, dust and rock. People sometimes call it a dirty snowball.

quickWords.th: ก้อนหิมะสกปรก

pages.text: A comet travels around the Sun on a long, stretched path.

quickWords.th: ดวงอาทิตย์
เส้นทางยาวรี

pages.text: Near the Sun, some ice turns into gas. A fuzzy cloud called a coma grows around the comet.

quickWords.th: กลุ่มเมฆฟุ้ง

pages.text: The comet grows two tails: a curved dust tail and a straighter gas tail. Both point away from the Sun.

quickWords.th: ออกห่างจาก

pages.text: Most of the time, comets are far from the Sun. They are too faint for us to see.

quickWords.th: เกือบตลอดเวลา

pages.text: Some comets come back again and again. Halley's Comet returns about every 76 years and will come back around 2061.

quickWords.th: ดาวหางฮัลเลย์

pages.text: Comets leave trails of dust. When Earth crosses a trail, we see a meteor shower of shooting stars.
The comet follows its long path into the dark. Goodnight, comet. We will watch for you again.

quickWords.th: เคลื่อนไปตาม
